description: This file defines the CustomerOptionValue entity class, representing a customer's selectable option value within a specific schema. It includes fields for identifiers, code, image, descriptions, and relationships to merchant store and description entities, with JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: CustomerOptionValue
classes.description: Entity class representing a customer option value, with fields for code, image, descriptions, and relationships to merchant store and descriptions. Uses JPA annotations for ORM mapping, supports validation, and manages transient fields for file uploads and description lists.
